projects.name: Enterprise Customer Management Platform
projects.description: Designed a scalable enterprise customer management platform by developing responsive interfaces with React.js and secure backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs, improving application responsiveness and user productivity. Implemented JWT authentication, role-based access control, and optimized MySQL queries while containerizing services with Docker and deploying on AWS, enhancing security, scalability, and deployment efficiency.

projects.name: Cloud-Based Order Processing System
projects.description: Developed a cloud-native order processing system using Spring Boot microservices, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB, enabling reliable transaction processing across distributed services. Integrated asynchronous communication with Apache Kafka and optimized service interactions through REST APIs, improving system scalability, fault tolerance, and processing performance.

projects.name: Enterprise Employee Portal
projects.description: Built a responsive employee self-service portal using Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, and Express.js, streamlining employee profile management and internal business workflows. Automated build and deployment processes using Jenkins, Git, and CI/CD while implementing comprehensive API validation with Postman, improving release quality and reducing deployment effort.
